system.description:
You seize an animal spirit in your grasp and tear its essence loose, devouring it whole; the wild fury of the creature floods through you, rekindling a will worn thin by the long night.

You may feed off an animal spirit to replenish all your lost Willpower Traits. Use of this power destroys the spirit, however, and it may be invoked only once per session. After using this Discipline, you may not access any other Spiritus powers for the remainder of the night.
